app.name: Moayad AR
onboarding.body1: Place 3D models in your real room with realistic lighting and occlusion.
onboarding.body2: Import GLB, glTF, FBX, or OBJ files and anchor them in your space so they stay where you left them.
onboarding.body3: Camera processing happens on your device. Nothing is uploaded unless you explicitly enable a cloud feature.
permission.cameraBody: Moayad AR uses the camera to understand your room and place models. Camera data is processed on this device.
permission.micBody: The microphone is only used when you record video with sound.
scan.needMore: More scanning is required before walls can occlude models.
anchor.relocalizeHint: Point the camera at the area where you placed the model.
anchor.persistentUnsupported: Persistent anchors are not supported in this session. The model will be re-placed manually.
import.title: Import Model
import.heavyWarning: This file exceeds the recommended budgets. Import may be slow and rendering may drop frames.
error.unsupportedFormat: This file format is not supported. Use GLB, glTF, FBX, or OBJ.
error.magicMismatch: The file contents do not match its extension. The file may be corrupt or mislabeled.
error.fileTooLarge: The file is larger than the configured limit ({0} MB).
error.tooManyTriangles: The model has too many triangles ({0}). Enable Heavy Asset mode to try anyway.
error.importTimeout: Import took too long and was stopped to keep the app responsive.
error.nativeImporter: The native importer failed safely. Try the GLB version of this model.
error.persistence: Could not read or write project data.
error.projectNewerVersion: This project was saved by a newer version of the app.
error.noRig: No rig detected in this file
error.noRigObj: OBJ files do not contain skeletons or animations, so Rig Edit is unavailable.
analysis.title: Model Analysis
analysis.warning.missingNormals: Missing normals — lighting may look flat
analysis.warning.highPoly: High polygon count for mobile AR
analysis.warning.suspiciousScale: Unusual size — check the suggested scale
autoscale.title: Suggested size
autoscale.reason.unknown: the file has no reliable size metadata, so this is an estimate
rig.title: Rig Edit
rig.ikUnavailable: IK is unavailable for this hierarchy — using FK.
capture.tapPhoto: Tap for photo — long press for video
capture.storageLow: Storage is low — recording may stop
realism.title: Realism
realism.ultraUnavailable: Ultra is unavailable on this device or while it is warm.
realism.impact: Higher realism uses more power and may reduce frame rate.
realism.raytracingUnavailable: Hardware ray tracing is not exposed by the graphics stack on this device. High-quality PBR lighting is used instead.
diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.summary: Camera frames and room data are processed on this device. No analytics, telemetry, or crash reporting is enabled. Cloud anchors are off unless you configure them yourself.
privacy.cloudAnchorsBody: Uses your own Google Cloud project. No keys are stored by Moayad AR.
privacy.noRawStorage: Raw room images are never stored unless you capture a photo or video yourself.
